propositions: merge.ours.driver is set per clone in init.py but never committed, so the reconcile-bridge.yml workflow runner does not have it defined
undefined merge.ours.driver causes git to fall back to 3-way text merge of the 18,231,660-byte .bridge_state JSON file instead of the intended local-wins behaviour
reconcile-bridge.yml must set merge.ours.driver=true for the tickets worktree before any merge step, while reconcile-bridge-canary.yml already obtains it via rebar init and needs no change
blob:none filtering with undefined merge driver causes lazy materialization faults during reconverge, requiring this fix as a prerequisite
reconverge against a diverged remote must resolve .bridge_state/* conflicts with local-wins semantics and produce no merge conflict markers
